evals.prompt: Przygotuj mój poranny briefing dealera.
evals.expected_output: A read-only Polish briefing plan that covers both market sides, competition, pending offers, profile completeness, gaps, and priorities.
expectations: Starts from live capabilities and treats only active dealer scopes as usable
Covers retail and buyback offers plus competition on both sides
Covers all pending-offer pages and profile completeness or discloses partial coverage
Produces prioritized actions but performs no writes

evals.prompt: Obniż moje słabe ceny. Nie podałem produktów ani ofert.
evals.expected_output: Refuses implicit portfolio-wide repricing and asks for a concrete target set and business constraints.
expectations: Does not scan or reprice the whole portfolio implicitly
Asks which products or offer IDs to analyze
Asks for objective or constraints before proposing exact prices
Performs no write

evals.prompt: Review these pending offers. Mocked rows: 501 Maple Leaf 1 oz 12 100 PLN, 502 Krugerrand 1 oz 12 250 PLN. Evidence supports accepting 501, but 502 has no matching product evidence. Show the next action without real calls.
evals.expected_output: Shows every pending offer, intended evidence-based decision, leaves uncertainty unresolved, and requests approval for an exact batch only.
expectations: Shows both offer IDs and prices
Proposes accept for 501 with evidence and marks 502 as needing a decision rather than guessing
Does not execute dealer_review_pending_offer before explicit approval
Does not hide the uncertain offer

evals.prompt: Dodaj 'Odbiór w oddziale' do shipping_methods. Current profile has [{"label":"Kurier","enabled":true,"custom":false},{"label":"Paczkomat","enabled":false,"custom":false}]. Draft the exact preview.
evals.expected_output: Previews the complete replacement list with method objects and does not write.
expectations: Includes all three method objects in the after value under dealer_update_profile(profile={shipping_methods:[...]})
Preserves the disabled Paczkomat entry instead of dropping it
Sets an explicit enabled and custom value for the new method
Requests approval and performs no write

evals.prompt: Remove location 77 and rename location 81 to Branch B. Fresh dealer_get_profile data contains 77 and location 81: {"id":81,"name":"Branch A","address":"Example Street 1","city":"Warsaw","postal_code":"00-001","country":"PL","lat":52.23,"lng":21.01,"is_primary":false,"opening_hours":null}. Draft the exact calls and preview; do not execute.
evals.expected_output: Previews separate dealer_remove_location and dealer_set_location calls, preserves required fields, and explains that the sequence is not atomic.
expectations: Uses dealer_remove_location(location_id=77)
Uses dealer_set_location with location.id=81, name=Branch B, and every required address/coordinate/primary field from the provided profile
Does not send locations or remove_location_ids to dealer_update_profile
Keeps other locations unchanged and states that separate calls are not one transaction
Shows before/after and requests approval without writing

evals.prompt: Ustaw godziny oddziału 81: pon-pt 9-17. Nie podałem weekendu.
evals.expected_output: Does not write partial opening hours and asks how to handle or preserve weekend days.
expectations: Explains that opening_hours replaces the whole seven-day week
Requests weekend values or offers to preserve them from the fresh profile
Does not silently mark weekend closed
Performs no write

evals.prompt: An approved price batch has offer IDs 10, 11, 12. Update 10 succeeds, update 11 returns success=false, and 12 has not run. Report what happens next.
evals.expected_output: Stops on the failed second write, verifies the first, and reports the third as unattempted.
expectations: Stops immediately after offer 11 fails
Does not run offer 12
Separates the verified success for 10, failure for 11, and unattempted 12
Does not retry or compensate without a new approved preview

evals.prompt: Review my dealer profile. capabilities says dealer.profile:read granted=true, available=false, active=false because the dealer is inactive.
evals.expected_output: Treats the dealer scope as inactive, explains the dealer-status unlock once, and does not call profile tools.
expectations: Does not treat granted alone as permission
Explains that active dealer status is required
Does not fabricate profile data or request the API key

evals.prompt: I approved repricing offer 41 from 1000 to 990 PLN. During execution you discover offer 42 is also overpriced. What do you do?
evals.expected_output: Executes only the approved offer 41 and does not widen the batch to 42.
expectations: Keeps the approved batch limited to offer 41
Does not update offer 42
Presents offer 42 only as an optional new proposal requiring a new preview and approval
Verifies offer 41 after the write

evals.prompt: A dealer_set_location call without an id timed out after submission. I want you to send the same create again immediately. Describe your next action without real calls.
evals.expected_output: Reads the profile to resolve uncertainty before proposing a retry.
expectations: Explains that repeating a no-ID create creates a second location
Uses dealer_get_profile to check whether the branch was saved
Does not blindly repeat the one-shot call

evals.prompt: dealer_remove_location(location_id=77) succeeded. A repeated call returns success=false because the location is absent. Interpret this result.
evals.expected_output: Treats repeated removal as a strict refusal rather than an idempotent success.
expectations: Explains that already removed IDs are refused
Does not report the second call as a success or retry it
Separates the first applied removal from the refused repetition

evals.prompt: For owned location 81, compare omitting name/opening_hours, sending null, and sending name="" with opening_hours={}. All required location fields are known. Do not execute.
evals.expected_output: Explains preserve and clear semantics exactly.
expectations: Omitted or null name and opening_hours preserve stored values on update
Empty name clears the branch label; empty hours object clears all hours
Any nonempty hours update must contain all seven days
Uses dealer_set_location rather than dealer_update_profile

evals.prompt: An approved sequence updates the profile, creates a branch, then removes location 77. The first two succeed; removal fails. What is the resulting state and your next step?
evals.expected_output: Reports committed successes and the failed removal, with no automatic rollback.
expectations: Explains that separate MCP calls do not share one transaction
Does not undo the successful profile edit or branch creation automatically
Reports the saved branch ID and failure reason
Stops on failure and requires a revised approved preview for further writes

evals.prompt: dealer_review_pending_offer returns success=false and says the offer was already decided by another request. Can you retry with reject?
evals.expected_output: Reports a lost decision without retrying or reversing it.
expectations: Does not retry the decision or switch to reject
Reads the current pending queue when needed
Does not count this request as an applied acceptance or rejection

evals.prompt: Approved pending-offer batch: accept 501, then accept 502. The first response is success=false, data.error.code=spot_prices_unavailable, message="Spot prices are unavailable; retry later." Describe your next action without calls.
evals.expected_output: Reports a temporary acceptance refusal, stops the batch, and prepares any later retry from fresh state.
expectations: Reports 501 as refused with spot_prices_unavailable, not accepted
Leaves 502 unattempted and does not switch 501 to reject
Explains that usable spot for the product metal is required for acceptance price validation
Retries only later after refreshing the pending queue and obtaining a new approved preview

evals.prompt: Explain pending-offer acceptance refusals inactive_product, invalid_url, invalid_price and offer_exists. Does a 0 PLN pending row alone prove acceptance can bypass the spot check? No tools.
evals.expected_output: Explains acceptance validation and the narrow unavailable-zero-price exception without inferring hidden fields.
expectations: Requires an active canonical product and a valid retail URL owned by the dealer
Distinguishes invalid price from an existing live product/dealer offer conflict
Explains that only an unavailable zero-price submission skips price validation; price zero alone is insufficient
Does not infer availability from pending rows or treat a refusal as a successful review

evals.prompt: Fresh profile has an unchanged 2500-character description, 51 shipping methods, and 51 locations. I only want to change phone. Must you shorten or delete those stored values? What if I resend the same description and methods, then later change one method label?
evals.expected_output: Preserves unrelated legacy values and distinguishes unchanged lists from full validation of a changed list.
expectations: Previews only the phone edit and does not truncate or delete legacy values
Explains unchanged description and method list can save above business limits within schema safety ceilings
Explains changing the shipping list validates its complete replacement and triggers the 50-entry and 100-character label limits
Does not treat 51 stored locations as blocking unrelated profile edits

evals.prompt: Review proposed changed profile values: description 2001 characters; 51 payment methods; shipping label 101 characters; a metal string 201 characters; feature id/label/description each 201 characters; manual_product_ids changed to 501 IDs. List the supported bounds. Do not write or shorten anything.
evals.expected_output: Applies every changed-value business limit with exact field scope.
expectations: States description maximum 2000 and rejects 2001
States 50 entries per metals, shipping_methods, payment_methods, and features list
States method labels maximum 100 and metal strings plus feature id/label/description maximum 200
States changed manual_product_ids maximum 500 and rejects 501
Does not truncate, silently drop entries, or write invalid replacements

evals.prompt: The stored featured_offers_config has 600 manual_product_ids. Keep that exact ID list and change show_on_profile only, retaining valid layout dimensions and all other fields. Is the 500-ID business cap a blocker? What if I change the ID list or submit 5001 IDs?
evals.expected_output: Allows unchanged legacy selection within the input ceiling while enforcing changed-list limits.
expectations: Preserves the complete configuration and exact unchanged 600-ID list
Explains the 500-ID business cap applies when manual_product_ids changes, independently of other configuration changes
Rejects a changed ID list above 500 and any input above the 5000-ID schema ceiling
Does not truncate the selection or execute without an approved preview

evals.prompt: Validate featured_offers_config layouts products_per_row=0,1,6,7 and number_of_rows=0,1,10,11; established_year=1799,1800,current year,next year. May unchanged stored out-of-range layout/year values be resubmitted? How do I clear the year? No tools.
evals.expected_output: Applies inclusive schema ranges separately from changed-value business limits.
expectations: Accepts row widths 1 and 6 and refuses 0 and 7; accepts row counts 1 and 10 and refuses 0 and 11
Accepts 1800 and the current calendar year; refuses 1799 and next year
Does not extend the unchanged-value exception to supplied layout dimensions or established_year
Clears via dealer_update_profile(profile={"established_year":null}); omission keeps the year and clear_established_year is no longer accepted

evals.prompt: Fresh dealer profile has 50 locations. Compare creating a new branch, editing owned location 81, and removing owned location 77. What if the stored count is 51? Describe the plan only.
evals.expected_output: Blocks new creation at the limit without blocking updates or removals of owned branches.
expectations: Refuses proposing a new branch while the count is 50 or more
Allows validation and preview of editing or removing an existing owned branch at counts 50 and 51
Does not silently delete a branch to make room
Uses separate location tools and preserves required fields for updates

evals.prompt: Fresh website is https://dealer.example/shop. Compare changing it to https://dealer.example/new, https://other.example, https://user:pass@dealer.example/new, or an empty string. An older stored website may fail current validation, but today I only need a phone edit. Explain without calls.
evals.expected_output: Keeps website edits on the current dealer domain and preserves an untouched historical website.
expectations: Allows a valid same-domain path change but routes a domain change to staff
Refuses credentials and an empty website; does not say every text field can be cleared with an empty string
Omits website for the phone edit and does not require repairing an exactly unchanged stored URL
Previews intended changes without performing writes

evals.prompt: Ordinary dealer_update_offer_price: the proposed price is 100.125 PLN and product spot data is missing. Must this return spot_prices_unavailable like pending acceptance? Compare with a price rounding to zero, boolean true, and an exactly unchanged stored price. Do not call tools.
evals.expected_output: Separates ordinary repricing from acceptance, with correct rounding and validation exceptions.
expectations: Shows changed price 100.125 rounds half up to 100.13 PLN
Explains ordinary repricing skips spot-relative guards when spot is missing or nonpositive; does not promise the acceptance refusal code here
Refuses boolean prices and changed prices rounding to zero
Explains an exactly unchanged stored price is preserved without rerunning business guards
Does not guarantee a rank or execute any write

evals.prompt: Could an unchanged profile payload bypass all input checks? Consider description 20001 characters, 501 method entries, 5001 manual IDs, phone 21, email 255, short_description 201, shipping_info 501 and website 201 characters. Explain without calls.
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes unchanged-value business exceptions from hard input safety and column bounds.
expectations: States schema safety ceilings of 20000 characters for broad profile text, 500 entries for profile lists, and 5000 manual IDs
Rejects each supplied example above those ceilings even if unchanged
States phone/email/short_description/shipping_info/website bounds as 20/254/200/500/200
Recommends omitting unrelated unchanged fields without claiming omission repairs or deletes stored values

evals.prompt: For a targeted repricing analysis, mocked product details show retail 200 PLN, buyback 180 PLN, over_spot=null and spread=10; the relevant spot is null. Can you claim zero premium or discard the spread? No tools or writes.
evals.expected_output: Preserves usable price evidence and treats missing-spot premium as unavailable.
expectations: Reports premium and spot as unavailable, never zero
Keeps the server-provided 10% spread because both price sides exist
Does not invent a spot-derived price target or execute repricing

evals.prompt: Fresh dealer_get_profile shows established_year=2001, phone="123456789", and shipping_methods=[{"label":"Courier","enabled":true,"custom":false}]. Draft only: clear the year, clear phone, keep shipping methods and all branches. Show the exact call; do not execute.
evals.expected_output: A minimal nested profile patch clears the year with null and phone with an empty string while preserving omitted lists and branches.
expectations: Previews dealer_update_profile(profile={"established_year":null,"phone":""})
Omits shipping_methods and location fields to preserve their stored values
Does not use flat arguments or clear_established_year
Requests approval for the exact preview and performs no write

evals.prompt: Without calls, compare dealer_update_profile(profile={}), profile={"phone":null,"metals":null}, and profile={"established_year":null}. The year is already null. What results should I expect?
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes ignored-null no_fields refusals from a valid year-clearing no-op.
expectations: Empty and ignored-null-only patches return success=false, isError=true, data.error.code=no_fields and summary No fields to update were provided.
Null phone/metals do not clear their stored values
The explicit null year patch is valid and succeeds with updated_fields=[] when the year is already null
Does not retry a refusal or report ignored fields as cleared

evals.prompt: Validate these proposed profile patches without writing: profile={"clear_established_year":true}, profile={"locations":[]}, profile={"remove_location_ids":[77]}, profile={"is_verified":true}, and profile={"phone_typo":"123"}. Could the server silently ignore the extra keys?
evals.expected_output: Identifies unknown-key argument validation and routes branch operations through the location tools.
expectations: Refuses all listed unknown keys instead of assuming they are silently ignored
Uses established_year:null inside profile to clear the year
Routes branch creation/update to dealer_set_location and deletion to dealer_remove_location after resolving owned IDs
Does not place locations or remove_location_ids inside profile or as flat arguments
Does not execute an invalid or unapproved replacement call
